pr_body:
Fix https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/110967

Calling `Rename.output()` previously returned wrong results.

Since https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110488, instead it throws an `IllegalStateException`. That leads to test failures in the `EsqlNodeSubclassTests` because e.g. `MvExpandExec` and `FieldExtractExec` eagerly calls `.output()` on its child when it's being constructed, and the child can be a fragment containing a `Rename`.
pr_comments:
Actually, there's other physical plans that eagerly compute their children's outputs. Had another failure for `FieldExtractExec`. I think it's more correct to just make `Rename` correctly compute its output.

I'll update the PR.
